rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Tiisu Mahjong · Differences from standard riichi

section1.title: Minimum Fu & Call
section1.line1: A hand needs at least 7 fu to win.
section1.line2: Calling adds no fu and no extra payout.
section1.line3: Call when tenpai; your hand locks, except a concealed kan that keeps the wait.

section2.title: Misfire Penalty
section2.line1: Declaring a win after Call with actual fu < 7 is a misfire.
section2.line2: Pay the other three: Z = fu × 700.
section2.line3: Z > 2100: banned from winning this round and the next.

section3.title: Table Bonus & Blue Chips
section3.line2: Self-draw remainders go to the table bonus pool.
section3.line3: The next winner takes the table bonus; dealer repeats add extra.

page1.title: Step 1 · Discard
page1.line1: On your turn, click a tile in the bottom hand row.
page1.line2: The drawn tile sits at the far right; click it or any other tile.
page1.line3: Not sure what to discard? Check the tenpai hint and remaining count first.

page2.title: Step 2 · Call
page2.line1: When your hand reaches tenpai, click Call.
page2.line2: After calling, your hand locks: you cannot change the wait, except a concealed kan that keeps the wait shape.
page2.line3: Calling adds no fu; a win below 7 fu is a misfire.

page3.title: Step 3 · Win & Settlement
page3.line1: Click Win on self-draw, or Ron when someone discards your winning tile.
page3.line2: The settlement page lists yaku, score changes, and round adjustments.
page3.line3: Click Next Round to continue; return to the menu after the match.
